en.paths.scope: Solar Amulet only. Supports 16 basic actions listed below, no Omens. Other bases, multi-stat new rolls and unsupported roll models are not calculated. This evaluates your explicit policy; it does not recommend an optimal path or select recovery automatically.
en.paths.observations: 100 / 300 / 500 are observation points, not a crafting cap. There is no maximum currency-use limit. Server computation limits can leave unresolved probability.
en.paths.model: Probabilities describe the declared simulator model, not verified game odds. Candidate weights use PoE2DB; removal and integer rolls use declared uniform assumptions.
en.paths.notReady: Calculation unavailable: use a verified current Solar starting item, no active Omens, and current probability provenance. Other bases are unsupported; this is not 0%.
en.paths.exactTarget: Match this exact catalog ID, not a tier-or-better, family or numeric goal. No target is selected automatically. Apprentice’s is spell damage, not +3 minion skills.
en.paths.single: Single pass — apply the list once
en.paths.recoveryNotice: Conditional on the failure item you explicitly saved. Recovery targets and methods are user-selected. Recovery success is never added to main success probability.
en.paths.captureCheckpoint: Save current item as recovery checkpoint
en.paths.captureFailure: Save current item as failure state
en.paths.statusNotice: COMPLETE: no unresolved mass at this observation. PARTIAL / UNKNOWN: success is bounded, not an exact 0% or 100%. Policy-ended mass does not prove global crafting or recovery impossibility.
en.paths.rounding: Percentages are truncated to five decimal places; probabilities below one never display as 100%. Exact fractions remain available.
en.paths.truncated: Additional blocker evidence was omitted by the server.
en.paths.evidenceNotice: Full source states and exact targets are shown for review only. These states are kept in this panel’s memory, not saved on the server.

ko.paths.title: Experimental basic-currency probability
ko.paths.scope: Solar Amulet only. Supports 16 basic actions listed below, no Omens. Other bases, multi-stat new rolls and unsupported roll models are not calculated. This evaluates your explicit policy; it does not recommend an optimal path or select recovery automatically.
ko.paths.observations: 100 / 300 / 500 are observation points, not a crafting cap. There is no maximum currency-use limit. Server computation limits can leave unresolved probability.
ko.paths.model: Probabilities describe the declared simulator model, not verified game odds. Candidate weights use PoE2DB; removal and integer rolls use declared uniform assumptions.
ko.paths.notReady: Calculation unavailable: use a verified current Solar starting item, no active Omens, and current probability provenance. Other bases are unsupported; this is not 0%.
ko.paths.exactTarget: Match this exact catalog ID, not a tier-or-better, family or numeric goal. No target is selected automatically. Apprentice’s is spell damage, not +3 minion skills.
ko.paths.single: Single pass — apply the list once
ko.paths.recoveryNotice: Conditional on the failure item you explicitly saved. Recovery targets and methods are user-selected. Recovery success is never added to main success probability.
ko.paths.captureCheckpoint: Save current item as recovery checkpoint
ko.paths.captureFailure: Save current item as failure state
ko.paths.statusNotice: COMPLETE: no unresolved mass at this observation. PARTIAL / UNKNOWN: success is bounded, not an exact 0% or 100%. Policy-ended mass does not prove global crafting or recovery impossibility.
ko.paths.rounding: Percentages are truncated to five decimal places; probabilities below one never display as 100%. Exact fractions remain available.
ko.paths.truncated: Additional blocker evidence was omitted by the server.
ko.paths.evidenceNotice: Full source states and exact targets are shown for review only. These states are kept in this panel’s memory, not saved on the server.

zh-CN.paths.title: Experimental basic-currency probability
zh-CN.paths.scope: Solar Amulet only. Supports 16 basic actions listed below, no Omens. Other bases, multi-stat new rolls and unsupported roll models are not calculated. This evaluates your explicit policy; it does not recommend an optimal path or select recovery automatically.
zh-CN.paths.observations: 100 / 300 / 500 are observation points, not a crafting cap. There is no maximum currency-use limit. Server computation limits can leave unresolved probability.
zh-CN.paths.model: Probabilities describe the declared simulator model, not verified game odds. Candidate weights use PoE2DB; removal and integer rolls use declared uniform assumptions.
zh-CN.paths.notReady: Calculation unavailable: use a verified current Solar starting item, no active Omens, and current probability provenance. Other bases are unsupported; this is not 0%.
zh-CN.paths.exactTarget: Match this exact catalog ID, not a tier-or-better, family or numeric goal. No target is selected automatically. Apprentice’s is spell damage, not +3 minion skills.
zh-CN.paths.single: Single pass — apply the list once
zh-CN.paths.recoveryNotice: Conditional on the failure item you explicitly saved. Recovery targets and methods are user-selected. Recovery success is never added to main success probability.
zh-CN.paths.captureCheckpoint: Save current item as recovery checkpoint
zh-CN.paths.captureFailure: Save current item as failure state
zh-CN.paths.statusNotice: COMPLETE: no unresolved mass at this observation. PARTIAL / UNKNOWN: success is bounded, not an exact 0% or 100%. Policy-ended mass does not prove global crafting or recovery impossibility.
zh-CN.paths.rounding: Percentages are truncated to five decimal places; probabilities below one never display as 100%. Exact fractions remain available.
zh-CN.paths.truncated: Additional blocker evidence was omitted by the server.
zh-CN.paths.evidenceNotice: Full source states and exact targets are shown for review only. These states are kept in this panel’s memory, not saved on the server.

zh-TW.paths.scope: Solar Amulet only. Supports 16 basic actions listed below, no Omens. Other bases, multi-stat new rolls and unsupported roll models are not calculated. This evaluates your explicit policy; it does not recommend an optimal path or select recovery automatically.
zh-TW.paths.observations: 100 / 300 / 500 are observation points, not a crafting cap. There is no maximum currency-use limit. Server computation limits can leave unresolved probability.
zh-TW.paths.model: Probabilities describe the declared simulator model, not verified game odds. Candidate weights use PoE2DB; removal and integer rolls use declared uniform assumptions.
zh-TW.paths.notReady: Calculation unavailable: use a verified current Solar starting item, no active Omens, and current probability provenance. Other bases are unsupported; this is not 0%.
zh-TW.paths.exactTarget: Match this exact catalog ID, not a tier-or-better, family or numeric goal. No target is selected automatically. Apprentice’s is spell damage, not +3 minion skills.
zh-TW.paths.single: Single pass — apply the list once
zh-TW.paths.recoveryNotice: Conditional on the failure item you explicitly saved. Recovery targets and methods are user-selected. Recovery success is never added to main success probability.
zh-TW.paths.captureCheckpoint: Save current item as recovery checkpoint
zh-TW.paths.captureFailure: Save current item as failure state
zh-TW.paths.statusNotice: COMPLETE: no unresolved mass at this observation. PARTIAL / UNKNOWN: success is bounded, not an exact 0% or 100%. Policy-ended mass does not prove global crafting or recovery impossibility.
zh-TW.paths.rounding: Percentages are truncated to five decimal places; probabilities below one never display as 100%. Exact fractions remain available.
zh-TW.paths.truncated: Additional blocker evidence was omitted by the server.
zh-TW.paths.evidenceNotice: Full source states and exact targets are shown for review only. These states are kept in this panel’s memory, not saved on the server.

es.paths.title: Experimental basic-currency probability
es.paths.scope: Solar Amulet only. Supports 16 basic actions listed below, no Omens. Other bases, multi-stat new rolls and unsupported roll models are not calculated. This evaluates your explicit policy; it does not recommend an optimal path or select recovery automatically.
es.paths.observations: 100 / 300 / 500 are observation points, not a crafting cap. There is no maximum currency-use limit. Server computation limits can leave unresolved probability.
es.paths.model: Probabilities describe the declared simulator model, not verified game odds. Candidate weights use PoE2DB; removal and integer rolls use declared uniform assumptions.
es.paths.notReady: Calculation unavailable: use a verified current Solar starting item, no active Omens, and current probability provenance. Other bases are unsupported; this is not 0%.
es.paths.exactTarget: Match this exact catalog ID, not a tier-or-better, family or numeric goal. No target is selected automatically. Apprentice’s is spell damage, not +3 minion skills.
es.paths.single: Single pass — apply the list once
es.paths.recoveryNotice: Conditional on the failure item you explicitly saved. Recovery targets and methods are user-selected. Recovery success is never added to main success probability.
es.paths.captureCheckpoint: Save current item as recovery checkpoint
es.paths.captureFailure: Save current item as failure state
es.paths.statusNotice: COMPLETE: no unresolved mass at this observation. PARTIAL / UNKNOWN: success is bounded, not an exact 0% or 100%. Policy-ended mass does not prove global crafting or recovery impossibility.
es.paths.rounding: Percentages are truncated to five decimal places; probabilities below one never display as 100%. Exact fractions remain available.
es.paths.truncated: Additional blocker evidence was omitted by the server.
es.paths.evidenceNotice: Full source states and exact targets are shown for review only. These states are kept in this panel’s memory, not saved on the server.
